en: I've lost weight lately!
Strange, since I haven't been exercising.
Please give this humble servant
note: joined: NAME, my master... / Please give this humble servant / any order you wish. (#962 variant for msg 94857)

en: I've put on muscle lately!
Off to work again today.
An official's life isn't an easy one.
Twenty-odd years I've worked at City Hall.
And I'm still just a lowly clerk.
You're, uh...
note: msg 94938 continues with #189 "."; the name is presumably inserted between 94930 and 94938

en: Are you coming to City Hall again today?
Lately I get lonely when I don't see you.
My work's done for today.
Maybe an official's job is easy after all.
I'm just an official at City Hall.
If you ever need anything, please
note: City Hall moved into #2415; #2494 (next slice, msg 95876) must end like this row so #2415 follows

en: come and see me at City Hall.
Will you come to City Hall again tomorrow?
We do keep running into each other.
What is it? What do you want?
If you're selling something, no thank you.
If you want to talk, come to City Hall.
I'm Martin. I work there.
Right now I'm building a model. My hobby.
I'll gladly hear you out at City Hall.
Ah,
How do you spend your free time?
I spend nearly all of mine on my hobbies.
Looks like
note: #983 is empty for msg 95120: Looks like NAME / has more time... (third-person address to the player, he = player)

en: has more time than he knows what to do with.
Having someone come visit me at home
isn't so bad at all.
Please, stay as long as you like.
My latest hobby is gardening.
Growing things is a real pleasure, you know.
This is the Administration Section desk.
How may I help you?
<Any vacant houses?>
<Tell me the town's sights>
Let's see, the houses reported vacant
at the moment are...
Ah, there are two of them.
One in the houses east of City Hall, and
one in Alster Park, north of City Hall.
No others seem to have been reported.
I see. Thank you.
Around Alster Park, north of City Hall,
fine shops line the streets, so you won't
get bored.
This is a trading town, after all.
There's no shortage of rare goods.
Oh, and also,
There's a monument in the northwest woods.
note: monument location shortened to the northwest woods to fit one line (also #2461)

en: It's so tucked away it's hardly worth
calling a famous sight, though...
You're welcome.
Oh, good of you to come all this way.
Now, what can I do for you?
It's so tucked away it's hardly worth calling
a famous sight, though...
Do feel free to come by again.
Hello,
note: Martin: Hello, NAME. Marie variants: 193316 Hello + ...; 193338/194055 NAME, + hello + ...

en: There's a monument in the northwest woods.
Have you heard of it?
If you have time,
why not go see it sometime?
Why, that's very kind of you.
Are there any vacant houses in this town?
I hear the mayor asked you to tutor his son.
Is that true?
The mayor's boy, you know...
He's caused all sorts of trouble at school,
and he's quite a handful, I hear.
Oops. Enough idle chatter. I'd better
get back to work.
Have you ever met our mayor?
Our mayor's motto is to stay in close touch
with the townspeople,
so you can meet him and talk directly.
I took you for a traveler, but you've
been staying here quite a while.
